map.252 是 A 股/美股年化交易日数（剔除周末与假日），波动按时间平方根法则累加: 252 is the annualised number of trading days for A-shares and US stocks (weekends and holidays excluded), and volatility accumulates by the square root of time, so the square root of 252 is used. Using calendar days would need the square root of 365, but that overstates real trading volatility.
map.σ_年 = σ_日×√252: sigma per year = sigma per day x sqrt(252)

map.不能。波动率是标准差口径，仅刻划离散程度，不预示方向。年化波动率 24% 不等于: No. Volatility is a standard deviation measure, describing only dispersion and not predicting direction. An annualised volatility of 24% does not mean "up 24% in a year"; it means daily returns fall within about +/-1.5% roughly 67% of the time.
map.为什么乘 √252 而不是 365？: Why multiply by the square root of 252 rather than 365?

map.：σ年 = 0.8% × √252 ≈ 0.8% × 15.875 ≈ 12.7: : σ_year = 0.8% × sqrt(252) ≈ 0.8% × 15.875 ≈ 12.70%. A low-volatility blue chip has an annualized volatility of about 12.7%.
map.：公式 σ年 = σ日 × √252。σ日=1.5% 时：σ年 = 1.5% ×: : Formula σ_year = σ_daily × sqrt(252). With σ_daily = 1.5%: σ_year = 1.5% × sqrt(252) ≈ 1.5% × 15.875 ≈ 23.81%. That is, the annualized volatility of this stock is about 23.8%.
